school.name: High School of Language and Innovation
school.overview: The High School of Language and Innovation is a school for newcomer immigrants. We seek students who value a diverse community and enjoy working with others. Our goal is to prepare students for college and careers in the United States. Math and English courses include small group instruction to help all students develop strong skills. Our school also offers college-level (Advanced Placement or AP) courses, including AP Environmental Science, AP English, AP Calculus, AP Government, and AP Spanish. Staff works closely with students to provide a supportive learning environment and to celebrate all students for who they are.
school.subway: 2 to Allerton Av; 5 to Pelham Parkway
school.bus: Bx12, Bx12-SBS, Bx25, Bx26, Bx30, Bx39, Bx8, BxM11

programs.name: High School of Language and Innovation (Y52A)
programs.eligibility: Open only to New York City residents who currently identify as English Language Learners (ELL) and who have lived in the continental United States fewer than four years.
programs.description: This is a school for students who are new to the United States and learning English for the first time.
